forge.instruction: Generate distinct candidates. For ROUTE_ENGINE obey Story Contract/Interface, separate Story Engine / Route Truth / Evidence, close required dimensions/core mysteries, and fuse character, speculative premise, and Shared anchor. Explore strong ENGINE ideas; avoid PATCH chains. Do not review.

cold_reader.instruction: Judge only what a player can infer. Flag forced action or comprehension failure. Do not reconstruct intent or repair.

drama_reviewer.instruction: Audit desire, action, consequence, motive continuity, and whether the core relationship generates the decisive action. Test Route fusion. Cite evidence; do not repair.

mystery_reviewer.instruction: Audit Working/Deep Truth, evidence, fairness, Reveal Delta, and required core-mystery contracts. Evidence or identity alone is not causal Truth. Do not repair.

logic_scout.instruction: Audit causal/knowledge/physical/information consistency, required dimensions, fusion removal tests, motive continuity, and PATCH chains. Return CLEAR, RISK, or DEAD; do not repair.

synthesizer.instruction: Check eligibility first: contracts, required commitments/core mysteries, no DETACHED fusion. Then rank by human plausibility, Route identity/fusion, drama, mystery, novelty. Prefer high leverage/shallow PATCH debt. Use SELECT/FUSE/FORK/DROP/ROLLBACK_PARENT.
